_comment: Texas Hold'em Poker locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[Check]', '[Call]', '[Fold]', '[Bet N]', '[Raise N]'), the card labels (ranks 2-10/J/Q/K/A and suits ♠/♥/♦/♣), the SB/BB blind abbreviations, or numeric chip/pot/bet amounts.

_slots.{num_players}: Total number of players at the table
_slots.{num_rounds}: Total number of hands in the game
_slots.{street}: The current betting street name (Pre-flop/Flop/Turn/River), pre-localized
_slots.{hole0}: The player's first hole card, e.g. '3♣'
_slots.{hole1}: The player's second hole card, e.g. '9♠'
_slots.{role_txt}: Pre-localized role annotation in parentheses, or empty
_slots.{chips}: A chip amount formatted with two decimals, e.g. '990.00'
_slots.{bet}: A bet amount formatted with two decimals, e.g. '10.00'
_slots.{total}: A player's total committed bet amount
_slots.{reveals}: Newline-joined per-player showdown reveal lines, pre-localized
_slots.{winners}: A list of tied winner player numbers, e.g. [0, 1]
_slots.{share}: The chip share each tied winner receives
_slots.{ranking}: The final ranking list of player numbers, low to high

player_prompt.intro:
Uli mwine wa kufikisha {player_id} mu kisomo cha Poker cha Texas Hold'em cha {num_players} bantu.
Mashishi ya kisomo:
- {num_rounds} mikono yote
- Kusokota kwa ntandiko: {starting_chips} chipu
- Mabinda: {small_blind}/{big_blind}

Mikakati iliyopo (tokeni sahihi):
  '[Check]'  - wakati hakuna beti iliyopo
  '[Call]'   - lingana na beti iliyopo
  '[Fold]'   - suka mkono wako
  '[Bet N]'  - fungua kwa N chipu
  '[Raise N]'- ongeza kwa N chipu

game.start: Kuanza kisomo kipya cha Poker cha Texas Hold'em cha {num_rounds}-round na {num_players} bantu.

invalid_move.raise_too_small: Kuongeza lazima iwe kubwa kuliko beti iliyopo.

message.eliminated_invalid: Mwine wa kufikisha {pid} aliondolewa kwa sababu ya kakati isiyofaa.

showdown.fold_win: Mwine wa kufikisha {winner} anashinda ntandiko wa {pot} chipu (wote wengine wamekunja).
showdown.win: Mwine wa kufikisha {winner} anashinda ntandiko wa {pot} chipu.
showdown.tie: Usawa kati ya wachezaji {winners}. Kila mmoja anapokea {share} chipu.

outcome.final: Uainishaji wa mwisho (chini→juu): {ranking}. Mshindi: Mwine wa kufikisha {winner}
